invariants.rationale: HoodieListData.eager(data) should always return a non-null HoodieData<T> instance.
Method is called with a non-null data List to be parallelized.
The returned result is exactly HoodieListData.eager(data) according to the method's implementation.
Method always returns the result of HoodieListData.eager(data), which is a HoodieListData instance.
No constraints enforced on parallelism within the method, so it can take any int value.
